mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate fenofibrate's effects on lipid metabolism and increase risk of adverse cardiovascular effects; fenofibrate may also inhibit platelet aggregation, compounding MAOI-related bleeding risk.
action: Monitor cardiovascular parameters closely; assess bleeding risk and consider alternative antidepressant if possible; use lowest effective fenofibrate dose with regular lipid panel monitoring.
